lede: The one story that crossed feeds today was a small embarrassment: Lenovo's 'encrypted' fingerprint USB drive turned out to be an ordinary unencrypted SD card in a fancy case, a finding that surfaced on both Hacker News and Lemmy. The biggest single number came from Wikipedia, where Haley Stevens drew 360,148 views, nearly double the runner-up, Patrick Stewart, at 205,436. Beneath that the day was mostly midterm betting markets and a magnitude 6.0 earthquake 165 km northwest of Port-Olry, Vanuatu. A quiet Monday, in other words, with one unlucky USB drive.

throughlines.title: Lenovo's 'encrypted' fingerprint USB drive is just an unencrypted SD card in a fancy case
throughlines.gist: Lenovo's security claim fell apart on inspection, and it was the only story today live on two feeds at once, Hacker News and Lemmy.
